Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with complaints of neck pain, restricted cervical range of

stretching instructions. Treatment followed a typical and expected progression, with visit frequency reduced as symptoms
steadily improved and range of motion returned toward normal. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly corroborate
the diagnosis of cervical strain. The patient reports no konwn prior injury or treatment involving the cervical spine. Billed
